# hacBrewPack (Placeholder)

This subdirectory is prepared for a future integration of [hacBrewPack](https://github.com/The-4n/hacBrewPack) (NSP packaging tool).

## Future Layout

```
third_party/
└── hacbrewpack/
    ├── LICENSE

    └── ...
```

## Security & Clean-Room Rules

- No cryptographic keys (e.g., `prod.keys`, `title.keys`) will ever be committed here.
- The tool operates purely with user-supplied key configuration files.
- Original author notices and licenses will be preserved without modification.
